settings.title: Settings
settings.hint: Saved for this agent in its history (unit agent.settings). Every field is in force from the next turn on: a saved value reaches the cache and a model that is already built.
settings.maxAgentsHint: 1–64: a create_agent call past the cap is refused.
settings.maxInputLengthPerTurnHint: 256–1,000,000: a longer line is kept in the cache and handed over trimmed.
settings.compressionThresholdHint: 1,024–1,000,000: above this many prompt tokens the oldest lines are summed up and forgotten, so one long conversation does not outgrow the window.
settings.compressionTokensHint: 256–262,144: how many tokens one compression forgets; keep it below the threshold.
settings.cacheSizeHint: 1–10,000: one more than this deletes the oldest cached text (NODE_AGENT_CACHE_SIZE is the fallback).
settings.allowSpawnHint: Off, create_agent is not offered and is refused if called; a saved child is no longer restored on start. A sub-agent never starts one, whatever this says.
settings.allowSearchCache: Let the model search the cache
settings.allowSearchCacheHint: Off, search_cache is not offered and a call is refused.
settings.allowAskUser: Let the model ask the reader
settings.allowAskUserHint: Off, ask_user is not offered and answers with its refusal: a turn that has to ask a person ends there.
settings.providerHint: Switched with the select above; shown here only.
settings.resetDone: Settings are back to this deployment’s defaults.
